# Entities

## Elements

### <a id="Beam"></a>Beam

A horizontal or near-horizontal linear structural member.

Its analytical bar is what structural solvers see.

- **Introduced in:** version 2
- **IFC:** `IfcBeam`, predefined type `BEAM`; type `IfcBeamType`

#### Type <a id="BeamSection"></a>BeamSection

Attributes set on the type are shared by every `Beam` of that type.

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Value | Presence | Set on | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `section_area` | area (m²) | required | type |  |
| `span` | length (m) | required | instance |  |
| `roll` | plane angle (rad) | default `0.0` | instance |  |
| `stations` | list of length (m) | default `[0.0, 1250000.5]` | instance | Positions along the axis where results are reported. |

### <a id="Wall"></a>Wall

A vertical element that bounds or subdivides spaces.

- **Introduced in:** version 2
- **IFC:** `IfcWall`, predefined type `STANDARD`; type `IfcWallType`
- **Property sets:** [Pset_WallCommon](property-sets.md#Pset_WallCommon)

#### Type <a id="WallType"></a>WallType

A named wall build-up shared by many walls. Attributes set on the type are shared by every `Wall` of that type.

#### Attributes

| Attribute | Value | Presence | Set on | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `thickness` | length (m) | required | type | Total thickness of the build-up. |
| `layer_names` | list of text | optional | type | Layer names from the exterior face to the interior face. |
| `height` | length (m) | default `2.5` | type, instance may override |  |
| `base_offset` | length (m) | default `0.0` | instance | Height of the bottom face above the storey. |
| `mark` | text | optional | instance | Short label shown on drawings. |

#### Representations

| Context | Level of detail | Depends on | Generator |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `footprint` | 100 | `thickness` | `wall::footprint` |
| `body` | 300 | `thickness`, `height`, `base_offset` | `wall::body` |

### <a id="Containment"></a>Containment

Places elements in the spatial structure, such as a storey.

- **Introduced in:** version 2
- **IFC:** `IfcRelContainedInSpatialStructure`

#### Roles

| Role | Played by | Cardinality | Exclusive |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `structure` | any spatial entity | one | no |
| `elements` | any element entity | one or more | yes |

### <a id="Voiding"></a>Voiding

- **Introduced in:** version 2
